armorRatio.description: Each physical hit loses armorRatio × the target's Armor, as a flat amount.

armorFloor.description: Armor can't take a physical hit below this % of its size. Absent or 0: enough Armor blanks a hit. Ignored when armorK is set.

armorK.description: Armor by the Path of Exile formula: a physical hit deals hit² ÷ (hit + armorK × Armor), so Armor is nearly linear against big hits and never blanks one. Replaces armorRatio and armorFloor when above 0; absent or 0, the flat cut.

unarmed.description: The basic attack of a unit with no weapon.

maxEnemies.description: Most living units on the enemy side, summons included.

enrage.description: A fight that runs past `after` ticks: every unit, on both sides, deals pct % more damage with hits and reactions, and pct more again every `every` ticks, so no fight stalls. Absent: fights run to the safety stop.

opening.description: At fight start each action is already partly charged: it's first ready after a share of its cooldown, rolled between min and max on the unit's dice for each action (but see slots). Absent: every action starts a fight on its full cooldown.

slots.description: A party unit's abilities start this many ticks charged, by the order they're slotted in (first, second, third), in place of the roll: the order is the player's to choose. Its basic attack still rolls.

slotShares.description: Step 5g: as slots, but as a share of each ability's own cooldown (0.75 is three quarters charged), so a slow ability's head start is long too. Wins over slots when both are set.

draw.description: Foes pick in proportion to draw, not Aggro. With d how far a unit's Aggro is from `centre`: above it, draw = centre × (k + max × d) ÷ (k + d); below it, centre × (k + d) ÷ (k + max × d). An ordinary unit draws `centre`; none draws more than `max` times that or less than 1 ÷ max; +d and −d cancel. `k` sets how much the first steps count. Absent: picks weighted by Aggro itself.

stagger.description: Copies of the same enemy start a fight this many ticks apart, one after another, so identical foes don't act in lockstep. Absent or 0: they start together.

lostCast.description: An action interrupted in its wind-up, or whose targets are gone when it resolves. retry (the default): no MP, no cooldown, so it can start again at once. cooldown: no MP, but an interrupted action goes on cooldown, as a cast that fizzles for MP does, and one that found no target costs the unit its recovery.

defeatedUnits.description: Knocked-out units stay down between fights until something revives them.

restore.description: After a won fight, every standing member regains these % of its max HP and of its max MP. Absent or 0: nothing restores them between fights (the core set's rule).

premiumChance.description: Chance each offered slot rolls a premium perk, if one is available.

repeatPicked.description: Can a perk already picked this run be offered again?

offerInapplicable.description: Can a perk no party unit can receive be offered?
